title: "UMD Biostatistics 2026: Schedule"
page-layout: full
execute:
  freeze: false
---

  
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (!requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("yaml")
}
library(yaml)

schedule <- yaml::read_yaml("_schedule.yml")
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

link_types <- list(
  lecture = list(emoji = "🖥️", label = "Lecture"),
  activity = list(emoji = "📋", label = "Activity"),
  homework = list(emoji = "💻", label = "Homework"),
  vignette = list(emoji = "📖", label = "Vignette")
)

cat('::::::::::::::::::: column-screen-inset-right\n\n')

for (wk in schedule$weeks) {
  heading <- paste0(
    "Week ",
    wk$week,
    if (nzchar(wk$title %||% "")) paste0(": ", wk$title) else ""
  )
  cat("###", heading, "\n\n")
  cat('::: {layout-ncol="2"}\n\n')
  for (mod in wk$modules) {
    topic_line <- if (nzchar(mod$topic %||% "")) paste("-", mod$topic) else "-"
    cat("####", mod$number, topic_line, "\n\n")
    for (key in names(link_types)) {
      path <- mod[[key]]
      if (!is.null(path)) {
        info <- link_types[[key]]
        cat(sprintf("- [%s %s](%s)\n", info$emoji, info$label, path))
      }
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
  cat(":::\n\n---\n\n")
}

cat(':::::::::::::::::::\n\n')

if (!is.null(schedule$assignments) && length(schedule$assignments) > 0) {
  cat("### Assignments\n\n")
  cat('::: {layout-ncol="2"}\n\n')
  for (item in schedule$assignments) {
    cat("####", item$title, "\n\n")
    cat(sprintf("- [📝 Assignment](%s)\n\n", item$path))
  }
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```
